summary:
I wrote $HOME/projects/llm/vllm/models.md (715 lines). It follows the updated ranking. A summary table lists the eight models that fit fully under vLLM v0.33.0. Each has a full recipe card: checkpoint and size, budget arithmetic, a complete docker run command, thinking and sampling, an OpenCode entry, caveats with open issues, and evidence.

The cards cover four ranked picks:
- gpt-oss-20b (rank 9): 65536 needs util 0.95, FP8 KV and TRITON_ATTN. It also has a pre-download step that skips the duplicate original/ folder.
- Groot-19B-A3B NVFP4 (rank 8): language model only, 131072 with FP8 KV.
- K2 Horizon 7B (rank 4): cyankiwi AWQ-INT4 at 65536 with FP8 KV, effort high only because of #62743, plus a trust-remote-code warning.
- DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B (rank 10): chat only, online fp8_per_tensor, no tool flags, tools:false in OpenCode.

They also cover three honorable mentions (Gemma 4 12B QAT W4A16 at 131072 with FP8 KV, Qwen3.5-9B NVFP4 with MAX_JOBS=2, Mellum2.1 AWQ) and Gemma 4 E4B as the stack smoke test. Ornith-1.5-9B has a short note saying it is now excluded, because vllm/README.md still uses it as its worked example and calls it the vLLM primary. That is an inconsistency for the README owner or the lead to fix.

A further table lists 15 models that do not fit, with the smallest vLLM checkpoint, its size, the reason and where to run it instead, pointing to llamacpp/models.md.

Every command uses the README run template: CDI, port on 127.0.0.1 only, --memory 32g with an equal --memory-swap, no restart policy, and cache volumes. The eight OpenCode entries validated against the cached opencode schema with jsonschema 4.19.2: 0 errors, and a negative test was rejected.

I rechecked these live:
- K2 support first appears in vLLM v0.30.0 (k2_horizon.py is present at v0.30.0 and missing at v0.29.0).
- The 15.59 GiB Qwen3.8 AutoRound is grevinden/qwen3.8-27b-w4a16-autoround-rtx3090.
- The LFM2.5 NVFP4A16 build is 12.92 GiB.
- I rechecked all checkpoint sizes through the HF API.
- The vLLM flags exist in the local v0.33.0 clone, including --override-generation-config semantics and fp8_per_tensor.
- The gpt-oss recipe's tiktoken note.
- `hf download --exclude`.

No em or en dashes and no non-ASCII characters. No other file was touched.
unverified: Nothing was run on this laptop: every context window, VRAM margin and speed figure is arithmetic (1.2 GiB reserve assumed), not measured.
Groot NVFP4 language-model-only weight of 10.94 GiB assumes the vision tower equals the 0.84 GiB mmproj size; which chat template vLLM applies for Groot is unconfirmed.
Whether the k2_horizon reasoning parser picks up reasoning_effort from --default-chat-template-kwargs is untested; that the cyankiwi AWQ carries pre-FTPO weights is inferred from upload dates.
DeepSeek online FP8 resident size of 8.79 GiB is an estimate; 65536 with FP8 KV has only about 3% margin; the Intel INT4 AutoRound Marlin path on sm_120 is not checked.
--linear-backend cutlass avoiding the NVFP4 FlashInfer JIT for Qwen3.5-9B is inferred and untested.
TRITON_ATTN as the mitigation for #61239 is inferred, not upstream guidance; the MARLIN log line for gpt-oss is inferred from source.
The transformers version inside vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0 (needed for Mellum via the Transformers backend) was not read.
The AA Terminal-Bench 2.1 value of 13.9 for gpt-oss-20b comes from the ranking input; I only confirmed the value 0.1386 appears on the AA page, which embeds several models.
Community claim that Groot alters verbatim path text, and the Groot repo-id typo, come from the input records and were not re-read live.
The hf CLI --exclude flag was checked on huggingface_hub main, not against the exact version inside the image.
